EVAC PC LABEL PS4 component layout
=================================

This notice retains the component origins, revisions and licenses from the
maintained Ketsui source baseline. Local source paths below use that baseline's
names: src/ now lives in backends/ps4/, and third_party/gcn, third_party/gpu_core
and LICENSES live below third_party/ps4/. Build dependencies are pinned in
tools/ps4-source.lock.json and restored by scripts/ps4_sources.py to .deps/ps4/.
The standalone launcher and its packaging scripts are not part of this import.

Vulkan-Headers
==============

Source: https://github.com/KhronosGroup/Vulkan-Headers
Revision: ee3b5caaa7e372715873c7b9c390ee1c3ca5db25
Used for Vulkan API declarations, under the MIT license option.
The dependency checkout retains its original notices and license files.
No Vulkan loader binary is bundled. The program loads the Windows system
vulkan-1.dll and the installed graphics driver at runtime.

LLVM compiler-rt builtins
=========================

Source: https://github.com/llvm/llvm-project/tree/main/compiler-rt
License: Apache-2.0 WITH LLVM-exception
License text: https://github.com/llvm/llvm-project/blob/main/compiler-rt/LICENSE.TXT
The clang-cl toolchain supplies the statically linked x64 builtins used for
128-bit integer division in rational clock arithmetic. The exact runtime
library path and SHA-256 are recorded in build.json alongside the compiler.

shadPS4 hardware initialization data
===================================

Source: https://github.com/shadps4-emu/shadPS4
Revision: 529ceb32f5546b820588f194b903cc39d08015fe
Original: src/core/libraries/gnmdriver/gnmdriver_init.h, InitSequence350 and InitSequence350Neo
Local: src/graphics/ps4_init_350.h
Copyright 2025 shadPS4 Emulator Project
License: GPL-2.0-or-later; full text in LICENSES/GPL-2.0-or-later.txt.
The local file retains the base-machine and NEO 350 initialization data, without
the reference's synthetic clear-state preamble. No emulator core, loader,
kernel, application framework, or complete renderer is compiled from that project.

AMD AddrLib pipe addressing
==========================

Source: https://github.com/GPUOpen-Drivers/pal
Revision: 6353b182d28fe85f28b40d1809291b515fcddd3e
Original: src/core/imported/addrlib/src/r800/siaddrlib.cpp,
          SiLib::ComputePipeFromCoordWoRotation, ADDR_PIPECFG_P16_32x32_8x16
Local: gpu_core/upstream/src/video_core/host_shaders/tiling.comp
The NEO ALT layout uses the documented sixteen-pipe coordinate equations.
License: MIT; full text in LICENSES/AMD-AddrLib-MIT.txt.

Isolated GCN shader compiler
===========================

Source: https://github.com/shadps4-emu/shadPS4
Revision: 529ceb32f5546b820588f194b903cc39d08015fe
Local: third_party/gcn
License: GPL-2.0-or-later; full text in LICENSES/GPL-2.0-or-later.txt.
Original file notices and the source-file SHA-256 inventory are retained.
This includes work attributed in the source to the shadPS4, yuzu, Dolphin,
and Citra projects. Local host adapters replace emulator configuration,
filesystem dumps, signal handlers and generated SRT traversal code. Only the
shader compiler and selected AMD register/format definitions are built.

Shader compiler dependencies
============================

Exact commits and repository URLs: third_party/gcn/dependencies.json.
The following full licenses are retained for source and binary packaging:

fmt: MIT, LICENSES/fmt-LICENSE.txt
magic_enum: MIT, LICENSES/magic_enum-LICENSE.txt
Boost: Boost Software License 1.0, LICENSES/Boost-LICENSE.txt
Sirit: BSD-3-Clause, LICENSES/Sirit-LICENSE.txt
SPIRV-Headers: original license collection, LICENSES/SPIRV-Headers-LICENSE.txt
SPIRV-Tools-Headers: original license collection, LICENSES/SPIRV-Tools-Headers-LICENSE.txt
SPIRV-Tools: Apache-2.0, LICENSES/SPIRV-Tools-LICENSE.txt

Dependency checkouts preserve their original file-level notices. These
libraries are statically linked or used as headers; no emulator binary or
commercial shader program is shipped in the source tree.

Independent GPU-core integration target
======================================

Source: https://github.com/shadps4-emu/shadPS4
Revision: 529ceb32f5546b820588f194b903cc39d08015fe
Local: third_party/gpu_core/upstream
License: GPL-2.0-or-later; full text in LICENSES/GPL-2.0-or-later.txt.
Original file notices and SHA-256 inventory: third_party/gpu_core/upstream-files.json.
The runtime integration extracts Vulkan device setup, command pools,
timeline semaphores, scheduling, buffers, staging pools, image resources,
transfer synchronization, blit helpers, full buffer/texture caches, page watch
accounting and AMD format conversion. A configured host-memory interface supplies
backing reads/writes, protection, protected accesses and GPU-thread dispatch;
the upstream emulator memory manager, signal dispatcher and CPU core are not built.
The passive GPU-memory statistics header is retained; no UI implementation is built.
Host adapters supply
logging, thread names, explicit GPU settings, paths and a non-owning window
descriptor. No upstream SDL, GUI, kernel, loader or emulator application target
is compiled. The upstream Vulkan application name remains unchanged in this
integration target. These components provide the PS4 games' active renderer.

The separate KetsuiGpuRecompiler target also builds the complete upstream GCN
frontend, IR passes and SPIR-V backend with Sirit. Descriptor dependency analysis
is retained, while generated x86 SRT walkers and emulator signal-time repair are
replaced by a bounded portable traversal plan and coherent host metadata reads.
Optional shader diagnostics use the selected upstream IOFile implementation with
Windows SDK APIs. KetsuiGpuRenderer builds the graphics/compute pipelines and
rasterizer. KetsuiGpuRuntime.dll keeps their Shader/Vulkan types private behind
a versioned SDK, using the host's existing memory allocator through callbacks.
The adapted register-state facade is not the upstream command processor.
Unconfigured disk-cache/debug-patching entry points and title-specific shader
HLE are omitted; normal shader compilation and resource binding are retained.
The host presenter uses the resident texture cache, the existing GPL fullscreen
triangle shader and a project-maintained sampling shader. Win32 surfaces use
maintenance1 present fences; no upstream GUI or application presenter is linked.
The renderer test uses authored GCN, native shared backing, actual pixel readback,
linear/tiled presentation, and late window binding. Test fixtures are separate
from the player runtime and are not bundled with the program package.

Additional exact dependency commits: third_party/gpu_core/dependencies.json.
VulkanMemoryAllocator: MIT, LICENSES/VMA-LICENSE.txt.
robin-map: MIT, LICENSES/robin-map-LICENSE.txt.
Tracy headers (profiling disabled): BSD-3-Clause, LICENSES/Tracy-LICENSE.txt.
half: MIT, LICENSES/half-LICENSE.txt.
glslang (build-time compiler for the open-source host shaders): bundled license
collection in LICENSES/glslang-LICENSE.txt. Host GLSL sources are included in
upstream-files.json; generated SPIR-V headers stay in out/gpu-core.
Abseil: Apache-2.0, LICENSES/Abseil-LICENSE.txt.
xxHash: BSD-2-Clause, LICENSES/xxHash-LICENSE.txt.
The fixed Vulkan-Headers, fmt, Boost and magic_enum dependencies above are
shared. Dependency checkouts retain their original notices and licenses.

HEVAG predictor coefficients
===========================

Source: https://github.com/vgmstream/vgmstream
Commit: db77f98f405a45ad08df98aa444cae3848f95e6c
File: src/coding/psv_decoder.c (128-entry coefficient table)
Local location: src/audio/hevag_coefficients.h
License: ISC-style permission notice, LICENSES/LicenseRef-vgmstream.txt.
The bounded decoder, file profile and tests are maintained in this project;
vgmstream's file framework, player and stream objects are not linked.

SDL input
=========

Source: https://github.com/libsdl-org/SDL
Version: 3.4.18
Commit: 829a65d769d935c4852f8159e964312c0957260a
License: zlib, LICENSES/SDL-LICENSE.txt.
Restored as a pinned source dependency by Prepare-NativeDeps.ps1 and linked
statically into the native host. Only gamepad/joystick/event support is used;
SDL video, audio, renderer and GPU subsystems are disabled. Our Win32 window,
keyboard messages, Vulkan backend and WASAPI implementation remain separate.

ATRAC9 decoder
==============

Source: https://github.com/shadps4-emu/ext-LibAtrac9
Upstream: https://github.com/Thealexbarney/LibAtrac9
Commit: 946e05a9212976626a9f5e52f29c0a7202871f29
License: MIT, LICENSES/LibAtrac9-MIT.txt.
Pinned C decoder sources are linked statically; this revision includes bounded
bitstream reads. Our RIFF parser, NGS2 adapter, budgets and tests are separate.
No commercial waveform files are part of the source repository.

Community JSON
==============

Source: https://github.com/nlohmann/json
Version: 3.12.0
Commit: 55f93686c01528224f448c19128836e7df245f72
License: MIT, LICENSES/nlohmann-json-MIT.txt.
The pinned single header is used for bounded community protocol parsing and
serialization. It is restored as source; no separate JSON DLL is required.

Community replay envelope codec
===============================

Source: https://github.com/madler/zlib
Version: 1.3.2
Commit: da607da739fa6047df13e66a2af6b8bec7c2a498
License: zlib, LICENSES/zlib-LICENSE.txt.
The pinned memory-only inflate and deflate sources are linked statically,
with prefixed symbols. No gzip file API, tool, or extra DLL is included.
Envelope bounds, record inspection, round-journal integration, file entry
points and authored fixtures are project code.
